# Nexchem

> Industrial solvents, lubricants and adhesives for industrial buyers in Pakistan. Nexchem lists its head office in Lahore.

Official website: https://nexchem.pk/

## Product catalogues

- [Industrial solvents](https://nexchem.pk/Industrial-Solvents.html): Acetate esters, isopropyl alcohol, glycols and other industrial chemicals.
- [Industrial lubricants](https://nexchem.pk/Industrial-Lubricants.html): Industrial and pharma-grade white oils and specialty lubricants.
- [Industrial adhesives](https://nexchem.pk/Industrial-Adhesives.html): Paste, TPR and TPU adhesives for footwear and sports goods manufacturing.

## Company and procurement

- [About Nexchem](https://nexchem.pk/about.html): Industrial Solution Leaders (ISL) and Lahore Chemical House (LCH) profiles.
- [Testing facility](https://nexchem.pk/Testing-Facility.html): Laboratory testing and product documentation enquiries.
- [Quality policy](https://nexchem.pk/Quality-Policy.html): Nexchem’s approach to product quality.
- [Buyer questions](https://nexchem.pk/faq.html): Grades, packaging, documents and quotations.
- [Contact the Lahore office](https://nexchem.pk/contact.html): Address, directions, office hours and enquiry routes.

Confirm grades, packaging, availability and product specifications with Nexchem. For handling and safety, request the current grade-specific SDS.
